emulator: emulator-5586, AVD gould012-release, API36 x86_64 google_apis, ro.kernel.qemu=1, 2048MB/4cores, headless -gpu swangle
environment_note: Emulator 37.2.12 host-GL gfxstream segfaults on this host (SIGSEGV in TextureResize/ColorBuffer, coredumps at 03:26, 03:30 and a boot-time swiftshader_indirect crash at 03:32). All reported emulator numbers were therefore measured under the fully software ANGLE/SwiftShader swangle renderer; absolute timings are inflated versus GPU rendering and matched A/B comparisons under the identical renderer are the governing signal.

startup_ab_matched.method: trusted 0.11 published APK seeded with identical protected fixture, then in-place upgrade to 0.12; am start -W TotalTime after force-stop; 30 samples per side on the same emulator/renderer/fixture (scripts/verify_emulator_upgrade.py)
startup_ab_matched.result: PASS — no startup regression; candidate median is 2.2% lower than the matched 0.11 baseline and both medians are below the 1980 ms investigation threshold even under software rendering
startup_ab_matched.caveat: Emulator cold-process samples after initialization, not install-to-usable or physical-device timing.

corroborating_host_gpu_run: Pre-harness 0.11 baseline on the same AVD with host Mesa GPU (before the gfxstream instability surfaced): 5 launches median 883 ms, idle PSS 55766-56805 KiB — recorded as .gradle/gould012-checks/stable-release/perf-baseline-hostgl.json; confirms the app is not intrinsically slow on a GPU renderer.

idle_pss.result: PASS — post-upgrade idle PSS sits inside the 0.11 baseline range and far below the 143471 KiB investigation threshold; +12 MB vs the fresh baseline is explained by the seeded 37-session fixture data.

frames.method: deterministic monkey sweep, seed 20261029, 400 events, throttle 40ms, dumpsys gfxinfo
frames.result: No regression — candidate percentiles are lower than baseline (p90 1400 vs 2000, p95 1850 vs 4000). Janky-frame saturation is a software-renderer artifact affecting both sides equally; no numeric frame gate exists in the documented guards.

storage.result: PASS — no abnormal growth; candidate total is below the fresh baseline and databases grow only ~74 KB for the seeded 37-session data.

widget_wakeups: Not re-measured at release; widget provider XML retains updatePeriodMillis=0 (no implicit system wakeups) and the bounded 6h WorkManager refresh was accepted in docs/planning/gould-0.12/WIDGET-LAUNCHER-ACCEPTANCE.md. Recorded as reused prior acceptance, not a new measurement.
